title: Course Completion Time
description_html:
You are given a list of courses defined as:

class Course {
    int id;
    int time;                     // time required to complete the course
    List<Course> prevCoursesList; // prerequisite courses
}

You are also given a list of root courses (courses with no prerequisite).

Additionally, there is an API that you can call to determine if you fail a class after taking it. If you fail the class you must retake it.

Determine the total time required to successfully complete all courses.

Notes

  • A course can be taken only after all its prerequisites are completed.
  • Multiple courses may be taken in parallel if their prerequisites are satisfied.

Approach hint

  1. Build the DAG. Compute indegree[c] from prevCoursesList.
  2. Topo by layers (BFS). Initial queue = the roots. Each layer's wall-clock time = max(course.time) across the layer; total = sum of layer maxes (parallel execution within a layer).
  3. Retakes. After each course's attempt, call the failure API. If failed, queue an immediate retake on that course (its effective time becomes retakes × course.time). Retakes don't block the layer's other courses but DO push the layer's wall-clock if this course was the layer's max.
  4. Result. Total wall-clock = sum over layers of max(per-course total time).

Closest LC patterns: LC 2050 (Parallel Courses III — DAG longest weighted path, direct match), LC 1494 (Parallel Courses II — semester scheduling), LC 210 (Course Schedule II — topological order), LC 1857 (Largest Color Value in a Directed Graph — DAG longest path generalized), LC 329 (Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix — DFS + memo on DAG), LC 269 (Alien Dictionary — topo with implicit edges).

Related customs already in the archive: #10019 (Compute total time to finish all courses — parallel layers + critical path), #10012 (Schedule prerequisite classes with retakes — the retake semantics half).
